import http.server, time
start = time.time()
class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        healthy = time.time() - start < 45
        self.send_response(200 if healthy else 503)
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(b'ok' if healthy else b'wedged')
    def log_message(self, *a):
        print('%s answered %s' % (self.path, 200 if time.time() - start < 45 else 503), flush=True)
print('serving on 8000, healthy for the first 45s', flush=True)
http.server.HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', 8000), H).serve_forever()
